produced_by: bench/measure_clip_loudness.py over solnosage_five.json; ffmpeg ebur128=peak=true on the first audio stream of each muxed clip
note: just-Sol arms measured 2026-09-05, per-clip levels only (one rung, so no within-record delta); read beside the per-arm rows of bench/results/2026-09-04_ladder_audio_loudness.json for the same scenes' sage and sol levels; the tau-1.2 subway arm is absent because its label does not split as scene_rung
reading: descriptive. One clip per arm, so a per-scene delta is a paired draw from two different samples, not a measurement of the rung; the sign summary counts how many scenes agree, which is the most this record can say. A seed sweep per arm is what would turn a delta into a level difference.

units.integrated_lufs: EBU R128 integrated loudness, LUFS (higher is louder)
units.delta_lufs: rung integrated loudness minus the scene's baseline rung
